interface.shortDescription: Create character art, TF comics, and sticker packs.
interface.longDescription: Bunch: Character Studio is a Codex / ChatGPT Desktop skill plugin for character generation, targeted image repair, transformations, and personalized reaction sticker packs. The sticker workflow interviews for communication style, approves ten reaction performances, blocks poses cheaply, repairs one sticker at a time, applies character references only after pose approval, and can publish approved static sets to Telegram from a local helper. It can also route an explicitly named private DIDdy alter through an installed local bridge without publishing private references. Plan and render transformation comics with staged anatomy, panel continuity, individual panel repair, readable lettering, and accessible transcripts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me define a character, transform a photo, make a TF comic or sticker pack, or repair character art.
